audience: Laravel developers who host their sites on servers managed with Laravel Forge

useCases.title: List our servers and the sites on them
useCases.text: Lists your organizations and the servers in one, then the sites on a server, so you can see what runs where.

useCases.title: Find out why a deployment failed
useCases.text: Reads the deployment status and history of a site and the log of one deployment, so you can see where it went wrong.

useCases.title: Review a server's scheduled jobs, databases and monitors
useCases.text: Lists the cron jobs, the database schemas and the monitors (CPU, disk and similar) of a server in one summary.

useCases.title: Check the recent events of a server
useCases.text: Reads a server's details and its provisioning and activity events, so you can see what happened to it lately.

useCases.title: Deploy a site and check the result
useCases.text: Starts a new deployment of a site, which runs its deployment script, then checks the status of that deployment.

useCases.title: Run a shell command in a site's directory
useCases.text: Runs a command you give in the directory of a site on its server. It can run any command, so check it before you confirm.
